question: Do exact retained CC0 DNG metadata rows expose structurally valid and dimensionally distinct Adobe DNG ProfileHueSatMap tables that justify a separately frozen private explicit-operator arithmetic leaf?

source.rights: CC0/Public Domain per exact raw.pixls.us source rows

rules.data_count: Each Data tag contains HueDivisions * SaturationDivisions * ValueDivisions * 3 finite values in value-hue-saturation order.
rules.entry_semantics: Each triplet is hue shift degrees, saturation scale, value scale.
rules.zero_saturation: Every saturation-index-zero entry has value scale exactly 1.0.
rules.encoding: Absent ProfileHueSatMapEncoding means linear encoding value 0.
rules.dynamic_range: Absent ProfileDynamicRange means Standard Dynamic Range.

stop_rule: A missing/conflicting tag, identity mismatch, invalid dimension/count, nonfinite value, zero-saturation rule failure or SDK authority mismatch closes this exact source structure without replacement or operator implementation. A pass opens only a separately preregistered private interpolation arithmetic D0 with an independent oracle.
claim_ceiling: Private consumed-metadata DNG ProfileHueSatMap source-structure eligibility only. No interpolation conformance, colour/image quality, arbitrary DNG, RAW rendering, package, schema, capability, film-stock or product claim.
